trailhead.label: Top station of the Verdins–Tall cable car, the board’s start

cautions: About 690 m of descent: hard on knees and paws, take it slowly.
Meadows beside the path are farmed and closed to dogs in Schenna in the growing season: keep to the path.
Farm roads through Prenn and Untertall: lead on for passing cars and tractors.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Meadows beside the path are farmed and c: I prati accanto al sentiero sono coltivati e a Schenna sono vietati ai cani durante la stagione vegetativa: resta sul sentiero.
textIt.Farm roads through Prenn and Untertall:: Strade agricole attraverso Prenn e Untertall: guinzaglio per le auto e i trattori di passaggio.
